covers_site.determination: REPORTING FIELD, NOT COVERAGE. covers_site = item_match AND covers_current (consumer_closure.py:31936), and covers_current only tests whether a line range parsed out of the boundary's disposition prose contains the coordinate. The instrument's own comment (31754-31758) states that a line range 'may never establish a discharge, and it is not part of the acceptance predicate'. The acceptance predicate is identity_match AND span_classification is None, plus a discharging disposition and span-hash equality, with uniqueness over the identity tuple.

The value did not change at b84.
covers_site.can_support_a_discharge: yes, on the content-migration footing (same qualified identity + normalised-text hash equality at an ancestor + census attribution at the candidate + uniqueness), which is what the seven use. It is not a per-site receipt (site_receipt is null) and it does not claim the disposition's prose range covers the site.
